description: This file defines the PHP class `ProjectQuickCreate`, which extends the `QuickCreate` class. It manages the behavior and rendering of a quick creation form for the 'Project' module within SuiteCRM, including setup of JavaScript interactions, form processing, and AJAX handling.

classes.name: ProjectQuickCreate
classes.description: A class that extends QuickCreate to handle the AJAX and form processing for creating Project records quickly within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles form processing, setup of JavaScript, localization, and AJAX behavior for the Project quick create form.
